name: planning-with-files
description: Claude Code fork of planning-with-files (Manus-style persistent planning files). Hooks run from hooks/hooks.json (reliable, avoids skill-frontmatter bug #17688) and add local customizations: per-session plan binding, auto-bind on init-session, 临时任务 suppression, and .hooks_mode gating. Dir-based .planning/<id>/ plans with per-session read anchoring (anti cross-plan read). v2.43.0-claude.4 stops instructing the agent to run resolve-plan-dir.sh manually (not session-aware in a plain shell → wrong .active_plan fallback); the agent uses hook-injected canonical paths + the PLAN_ID printed by init-session — on top of the official attestation, PreCompact, and security framing.
